basic_profile.bio: A 36-year-old sous chef living in Portland, Oregon, with a passion for kitchen efficiency and organization. Outside the kitchen, I’m a big fan of sugargliders and love sharing tips on their care. I also enjoy making new friends and connecting on Discord. When I'm not working late hours, I enjoy exploring the local food scene with my wife. I dislike clutter and disorganization, which is why I carry FIFO practices into my personal life. I usually browse Reddit during late hours after my shift or early in the morning before heading to work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having worked in professional kitchens for over 15 years, I have developed a deep understanding of culinary techniques and kitchen management, largely through hands-on experience and mentorship from seasoned chefs. My interest in maintaining organized spaces extends beyond work, motivating me to engage in discussions about FIFO practices in various aspects of life.
